authoritative_sources.instrument: Decreto No. 36-2013 — Ley de Compras Eficientes y Transparentes a través de Medios Electrónicos
authoritative_sources.role_in_adjudication: Establishes that provider offers are selected into the catalogue upstream and that the individual entity issues the order directly to a chosen catalogue provider.
authoritative_sources.short_source_phrase: gestionará de manera directa ... la Orden de Compra al proveedor escogido

authoritative_sources.instrument: Acuerdo Ejecutivo No. 00641-2014 — Reglamento de la Ley de Compras Eficientes y Transparentes a través de Medios Electrónicos
authoritative_sources.role_in_adjudication: Separates the upstream selection/offer stages from the later purchase-order stage; the minimum-offer rule attaches to the selection process.
short_source_phrases: acta de recepción y apertura de ofertas
no se presentaren tres ofertas como mínimo

authoritative_sources.role_in_adjudication: Binds the exact subject to an individual catalogue purchase order rather than to the upstream framework selection process.

authoritative_sources.instrument: ONCAE — Procesos de compras / Convenio Marco
authoritative_sources.role_in_adjudication: Confirms that ONCAE selects providers and their offers for incorporation into the electronic catalogue.

framework_selection_stage.description: ONCAE conducts the competitive provider/offer selection that populates the electronic catalogue.

individual_purchase_order_stage.description: The acquiring entity issues a direct electronic purchase order to a provider already selected and catalogued.
